chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Subbah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man for whom one of his sons has a slave girl, while his sons are young, is it permissible for him to sleep with her? He (peace be upon him) said: He should evaluate her at a just price, then take her, and the price of her shall be upon him for his son.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a father wants to sleep with a slave girl owned by his young son?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the mechanism of 'Iqat' (acquisition) where a father purchases his minor son's slave girl to consummate the marriage, treating the payment as a debt owed to the son. It highlights the juristic distinction between the son's ownership rights and the father's right of consummation, ensuring the son's property value is preserved even as the girl transitions to the father's possession. This ruling underscores the practical application of property law within the master-slave marital framework in Shia jurisprudence.
